body.statement: If \(X_n\) converges in distribution to \(X\) and \(Y_n\) converges in probability to a constant \(c\), then sums and products converge to the corresponding sum and product; if \(c\neq0\), then \(X_n/Y_n\) converges in distribution to \(X/c\).

attestation.note: The displayed scalar quotient form is the cited Slutsky lemma; a stable book DOI is supplied.
